blocks.html: One of 36 Union County parks, Conant Park is Hillside's most well-rounded outdoor destination. Soccer fields, a softball field, basketball courts, a fitness trail, an outdoor gym, a 1.1-mile walking path along the Elizabeth River, picnic tables with grills, and free WiFi make it a genuine community hub worth spending time in.

A hot buffet featuring Feijoada, Farofa, and Pão de Queijo, a fresh salad bar, and handcrafted Caipirinhas round out a dining experience that feels like a genuine celebration every time.

From classic pepperoni to specialty pies and comforting pasta dishes, it's the kind of neighborhood spot that earns its regulars one slice at a time.

blocks.html: Home to the Woodruff House and Eaton Store Museum, the Hillside Historical Society preserves the township's origins through rotating exhibits, vintage photo archives, and a dedicated Phil Rizzuto Sports Exhibit honoring the New York Yankees legend who called Hillside home. The Grand Old Fashion Barn and virtual tour options add further depth to one of Union County's most distinctive local history resources.

items.q: How old do you have to be to get cannabis delivered in Hillside?
items.a_html: New Jersey's adult-use cannabis law is clear: you must be 21 or older to place a delivery order. Your age is verified when you create your Lady L account, and the driver will confirm your ID at the door before they complete the handoff. No exceptions apply.

items.q: What ID does Lady L accept for delivery?
items.a_html: Any valid, government-issued photo ID is accepted, including driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports. Out-of-state IDs are welcome. Your ID must be uploaded to your Lady L account before your first order, and the physical ID must be present when your driver arrives.

items.q: Do I need a medical cannabis card for Hillside weed delivery?
items.a_html: No medical card is required. Lady L is an adult-use dispensary open to any customer 21 or older. A confirmed Lady L account and a valid ID are everything you need to place your order.

items.q: What is the purchase limit for a single cannabis delivery order?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law allows us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. That total can include any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What are the taxes on cannabis delivery orders in New Jersey?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis purchases include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax, where applicable, and a $ 2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). These apply equally to delivery orders, and every applicable charge is itemized at checkout before you confirm.
